outputs.stage_description: Stage 2 (DSP) complete - All advanced features implemented

implementation_summary.sidechain_filtering: 2nd order Butterworth HPF (20-2000 Hz) and LPF (500-20000 Hz) applied to detector path only, not audio path. SC listen mode outputs filtered sidechain for monitoring.
implementation_summary.ms_processing: Power-preserving M/S encoding/decoding using sqrt(2) factors. Four modes: Off (standard stereo), Mid (compress center only), Side (compress width only), Both (independent mid/side compression).
implementation_summary.auto_makeup: Running average of gain reduction with 80% compensation factor, smoothed with 500ms time constant to prevent pumping artifacts.
implementation_summary.dry_wet_mixer: juce::dsp::DryWetMixer provides latency-compensated parallel compression with 0-100% wet mix control.
implementation_summary.processing_chain: Input Gain → Dry Capture → M/S Encode → Crossover → Per-Band (SC Filter → Compress → Auto-Makeup) → Sum → M/S Decode → Dry/Wet Mix → Output Gain

test_criteria_for_next_phase: Sidechain HPF reduces low-frequency compression trigger
Sidechain LPF reduces high-frequency compression trigger
SC Listen mode outputs filtered detector signal
M/S encoding preserves level (unity gain test)
Mid-only mode compresses center without affecting stereo width
Side-only mode compresses stereo width without affecting center
Auto-makeup compensates for gain reduction within 500ms
Dry/wet mix blends processed signal smoothly (0-100%)
